audit.why: 57.1% over 3452 games with an all-Fizz chart in both layers and the packet. Malzahar has no dash or blink; difficulty 4/10 holds and no row moves.
audit.corrected: Chart untouched; only the whys carrying a wrong mechanic were reworded.

audit.whatIsWrong: Void Shift was called a 'passive shield' in five places, and Void Swarm was described as a passive proc.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'When he hasn't recently taken damage or been crowd controlled, Malzahar gains massive damage reduction and crowd control immunity, lingering for a short period after taking damage.' It is not a shield, and while it is intact your CC does nothing. Void Swarm is an active W on a flat 8s that summons Voidlings at 150 range.
audit.corrected: Void Shift is now described as damage reduction plus CC immunity that has to be stripped first; Void Swarm named correctly.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three decisive interactions were missing: the silence on Call of the Void, the fact that Nether Grasp is an interruptible channel, and Malefic Visions as a delayed threshold threat.
audit.why: Call of the Void is a flat 6s at 900 range and silences — cast it on you and Playful/Trickster is not available, which is exactly the escape you were holding. Nether Grasp (700 range, 140/110/80) is flagged 'channel: interruptible — any CC cancels it', so Chum the Waters' knockup or the E slam ends the suppression. Malefic Visions (650, 11/10/9/8/7) is a damage-over-time that keeps ticking after you disengage and refreshes when his other spells hit you.
audit.corrected: All three now appear in cooldowns, carry, trading, dos/donts and spikes.

audit.why: The packet's suspectNames hit on 'His Nether Grasp' is a false positive — Nether Grasp is the real R name.
